facts.triple-crown: On his head is a gold triple crown, and a white band marked with small crosses hangs over his red robe.
facts.blessing-hand: He raises his right hand with two fingers up in a gesture of blessing.
facts.triple-cross: In his left hand he holds a gold cross staff with three crossbars.
facts.grey-pillars: He sits in a high seat between two gray stone pillars.
facts.two-ministers: In front of him, two people with shaved crowns kneel with their backs turned (one has red roses on his robe, the other a white flower pattern).
facts.crossed-keys: On the red rug at his feet, two gold keys lie crossed.

glosses.crossed-keys: A door opened by learning and tradition.
glosses.two-ministers: Not alone, but within a relationship of learning and passing on.

reversedGloss.excess: Fitting too closely to custom and rules feels suffocating.
reversedGloss.blocked: The place to ask for advice is closed off, or a formal procedure has stopped.
reversedGloss.internalized: An inward movement to set one's own standard in place of other people's.

misdescriptions.wrong: He is teaching while holding a book.
He is preaching in front of a large congregation.
He is seated between a black pillar and a white pillar.
